GET /api/intake/submissions/{submission_.reason: The share capture receipt polls the derived interpretation separately from custody so the original remains durable even when interpretation is delayed or needs correction.
GET /api/intake/submissions/{submission_.removal_trigger: Remove only when the mobile receipt no longer exposes source-bound interpretation state.

POST /api/intake/submissions/{submission.reason: Owner corrections are the smallest safe path from an uncertain interpretation to a source-bound memory without writing a canonical place automatically.
POST /api/intake/submissions/{submission.removal_trigger: Remove only if correction moves to a replacement, equally source-bound client flow.

GET /api/intake/submissions/{submission_.reason: The share capture flow needs an owner-scoped custody status to resume after a background or network interruption.
GET /api/intake/submissions/{submission_.removal_trigger: Add an approved mobile consumer or keep this transport server-only.

DELETE /api/intake/submissions/{submissi.reason: The owner must be able to revoke a private capture and its derived interpretation before it becomes part of a longer-lived memory.
DELETE /api/intake/submissions/{submissi.removal_trigger: Remove only when an equivalent owner-visible privacy control exists.

POST /api/intake/submissions.reason: The native share capture begins with an idempotent owner-scoped submission envelope before any bytes are uploaded.

POST /api/intake/submissions/{submission.reason: Finalization is the custody release point and must be retriable from mobile after every source object has server-computed metadata.

POST /api/intake/submissions/{submission.reason: Multipart custody upload avoids base64 navigation parameters and preserves the existing auth/retry transport.

GET /api/sites/{site_id}.reason: app/site/[siteId].tsx sources from GET /api/entities/site/{id} since the 2026-08-11 entity-envelope migration (data/sites.ts). The FE client method (api.getSiteDetail) was itself retired in the same effort (Slice 4) once a full-repo grep confirmed zero remaining callers — so unlike the usual transport-only case, there is no longer even an http.ts implementation to call. The standalone backend route is unchanged and still reachable — kept live for any other consumer and for its own route tests (tests/api/test_sites_route.py in travel-agent).
GET /api/sites/{site_id}.removal_trigger: Delete this route once nothing calls it — check for any other caller before removing (see docs/decisions/2026-08-11-entity-envelope.md, Slice 4).
